function.name: search_objects
function.description: Find named objects in the normal Solothurn search. Use the name, street and house number, or parcel number and locality, without the command or connecting words. For a specified land registry district use parcel number, district and municipality in that order. Omit filters for a broad search or select only configured filters supported by the request.

function.name: zoom_to_result
function.description: Navigate the open map to the unique verified object match. Use exactly zoom_ref from the latest search_objects response for this turn. Only use when the user requests navigation.

function.name: get_map_state
function.description: Read the actual QWC map theme, projection, center, scale and extent.

function.name: get_visible_layers
function.description: Read thematic layers enabled in QWC, including parent visibility.

function.name: add_layer
function.description: Show a layer or group using a real map layer ID from the Solothurn search.

function.name: remove_layer
function.description: Remove a layer or group from the current map using its real map layer ID.

function.name: zoom_to_lv95
function.description: Center the map at Swiss LV95 coordinates in meters and set the map scale denominator.

function.name: search_layers
function.description: Find maps and layers in the Solothurn Web GIS. Send a short thematic term, such as Gewässerschutzbereiche, without the question or location. Returns real map IDs and titles.

function.name: get_layer_details
function.description: Read Web GIS display metadata for a real map layer ID. Display metadata does not establish Data Service availability.

function.name: resolve_location
function.description: Resolve a Solothurn street address to an official LV95 point. Provide street, house number and locality when known, for example Klosterplatz 1, Solothurn. Ask the user to clarify ambiguous results.

function.name: query_features
function.description: Query features intersecting an LV95 point in a specific Solothurn Data Service dataset. Use an actual individual layer ID returned by search or given explicitly. An ID is confirmed only by the Data Service response. A successful empty result means no matches at the point.

function.name: present_layer_results
function.description: Show at most ten IDs returned by searches in this turn, in relevance order. Use an empty list to clear results when none fit.

search_only.description: Set true only when the user only wants to find maps and the list completes the request. The UI can then end the turn after showing it. Leave false or omit for requests that need further tools or explanation.
